title: Chung Hwa Peoples Anti-British And American Association To Give Cinema Shows And Concerts At Grand Theatre On July 7, 1942

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. N. 1271
Date 6 / 7 / 42

S.4-B.Special Branch...Station File No.................... Date July 6, 1942.

SUBJECT: Chung Hwa People's Anti-British and
American Association - to give cinema
shows and concerts at Grand Theatre on
July 7, 1942.

With reference to the attached report forwarded
by Officer i/c Chinese Affairs, I have to state that
the Chung Hwa People's Anti-British and American
Association(中華民族反英美协会) will hold a meeting
of cinema shows and concerts in the Grand Theatre, 216
Bubbling Well Road, between 2 p.m. and 5 p.m. and also
between 7 p.m. and 10 p.m. on July 7, 1942 to celebrate
the outbreak of the Loukiachow Incident.

Copies sent to
O. i/c S. r.
S.O. "B"
6/7.
Tm

When visited by the undersigned, Mr. Wong Pah
Yung(王伯庸) of the Association stated that approximate-
ly 4,000 complimentary tickets had already been issued
to persons in various circles concerned. It is
expected that some 2,000 persons will attend each
performance. Admission will be by the complimentary
tickets.

FILE

The programme will be as follows :-
1. Singing of Chinese national anthem.
2. Showing of a newsreel entitled "Liberation of East
Asia"(解放东亚).
3. A military march song to be played by an orchestra.
4. Showing of a German film entitled "Der Feldzug in
Afrika".

Police precautionary measures are necessary.

INDEXED BY
(S.B.) REGISTRY
DATE 6 / 7 / 42
Hung

G. Kimura
Officer i/c Censorship Affairs Section.

D.S.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处登记室
编号 N. 1271
日期 1942年7月6日

S.4-B.特别处……分局档案号……………… 日期 1942年7月6日。

主题：中华民族反英美协会——于1942年7月7日在大光明大戏院举行电影放映及音乐会。

参照附呈的由华务主管警官转来的报告，本人谨陈述，中华民族反英美协会（中華民族反英美协会）将于1942年7月7日下午2时至5时以及晚上7时至10时，在静安寺路216号大光明大戏院举行电影放映及音乐会，以庆祝卢沟桥事变爆发。

副本分送：
华务主管警官
“B”股警司
7月6日。
Tm

经本员走访，该会王伯庸先生（Wong Pah Yung）称，已向各界相关人士发出约4,000张赠券。预计每场演出将有约2,000人出席。凭赠券入场。

归档

节目安排如下：
1. 奏唱中国国歌。
2. 放映题为《解放东亚》的新闻片。
3. 管弦乐队演奏军乐进行曲。
4. 放映题为《Der Feldzug in Afrika》（非洲战役）的德国电影。

需采取警方预防措施。

索引编制者
（特别处）登记室
日期 1942年7月6日
Hung

G. Kimura
审查事务科主管警官。

副督察长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

S.1, Special Branch, File No.................... Date July 6, 1942.

SUBJECT: Chung Hwa People's Anti-British and
American Association - to give cinema
shows and concert at Grand Theatre
on July 7.

(批：Copy to
Seiya Station)

The Chung Hwa People's Anti-British and American
Association (中華民族反英美協會), Room 613
Hamilton House, corner of Foochow and Kiangse Roads
(Tel. 13837), arranges to hold a meeting of Cinema
shows and concert of the United and Renascence people's
of the Greater East Asia, in the Grand Theatre, Bubbling
Well Road, between 2 p.m. and 5 p.m. and between 7 p.m.
and 10 p.m. on July 7. It is expected that each
performance some 2,000 persons will attend. Admission
will be by tickets (specimen attached), which are given
free of charge by the Association.

The programme will be: (1) Music, (2) a picture
of war in North Africa, (3) Music and (4) a song of
freedom to East Asia.

Mak Hua-sen
D. S. I.

Officer i/c, Chinese Affairs,
Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

S.1，特别处，档案号……………… 日期 1942年7月6日。

主题：中华民族反英美协会——于7月7日在大光明大戏院举行电影放映及音乐会。

（批注：抄送
静安寺捕房）

中华民族反英美协会（中華民族反英美協會），办公地址福州路与江西中路转角汉密尔顿大楼613室（电话13837），安排于7月7日下午2时至5时及晚上7时至10时，在静安寺路大光明大戏院举行大东亚联合与复兴人民电影放映及音乐会。预计每场演出将有约2,000人出席。凭票入场（样本附后），门票由该会免费发放。

节目安排为：(1) 音乐，(2) 北非战争影片，(3) 音乐，(4) 东亚自由之歌。

Mak Hua-sen
副督察长。

华务主管警官，
特别处。

CHIN
Translation of a handbill

Open Letter to Shanghai Citizens on the entry of Japanese
troops into the Settlement.
Dear Citizens,
    The existence of the Settlement is a humiliation
to China and a blot on the Orient. Following the
Sino-Japanese incident, the Settlement has become the
"devils' den" of British and American imperialists and
a base of Chungking and communist elements for
committing various kinds of evils. The lives and
property of the five milion citizens have been threatened
and endangered and the splendid peace movement has been
unreasonably interfered with. We feel very indignant
when we think of this. Therefore, our sympathy is with
the Japanese troops who have now entered the Settlement
for the sake of China and the Orient.
    The entry of Japanese troops into the Settlement
has not only eradicated the British and American Base
for invading the Orient and also the Chungking and
communist influence but has also broken the chains that
have bound China since the Opium War of one hundred years
ago. The object of the Japanese troops is to safeguard
peace and order in Shanghai and to develop commerce and
industry, and therefore, we can believe that conditions
in the Settlement will soon show great improvement.
Our people, who form the majority of the Settlement
population, should remain calm and, under the guidance
of Chairman Wang, assist our friendly country in
establishing the new order in the Orient.

Shanghai Kuomintang Headquarters
(Wang Ching Wei's)
page_data.zh:
CHIN
传单译文

关于日军进入租界致上海市民公开信。
亲爱的市民们，
    租界的存在是中国的耻辱，也是东方的污点。自中日事变以来，租界已成为英美帝国主义者的“魔窟”，以及重庆方面和共产党分子从事各种罪恶活动的基地。五百万市民的生命财产受到威胁和危害，伟大的和平运动遭到无理干涉。思及此处，我们深感愤慨。因此，我们同情为了中国和东方的利益而进入租界的日军。
    日军进入租界，不仅铲除了英美侵略东方的基地以及重庆和共产党的影响，还打破了自百年前鸦片战争以来束缚中国的枷锁。日军的目的是维护上海的和平与秩序，发展工商业，因此，我们可以相信租界的状况将很快得到极大改善。作为租界人口大多数的我国人民，应保持冷静，并在汪主席的指导下，协助我们的友邦建立东方新秩序。

上海国民党总部
（汪精卫派）

page_data.en:
大東亞解放大會宣言

自十一月八日日本首相東條英機於大東亞會議之開幕以來，經過恰以三週，而該項任務已竣事。本月二十五日已將該會議
所通過三大決議發表之！的概況。完全公佈出來，我們茲因數文之事務冗忙之故，故又予以刊載，但至今遲回未出。
此次日本首相東條英機，日東條首相在會中所其演說稱：「日本此大行動乃本乎尊崇民族獨立繁榮，與大東亞同共榮回返即明之
原來性體」。又謂：「日本之立場，與其西之與七，在此一戰」。東條首相亦謂：「此大戰爭非為征服他國之性體」。日本政府
於各宣戰聲明後發表之聲明中更謂：「對日本之存亡，東亞之興廢，已顯於此一戰」。可見此大日本首相東條之誠意，並非虛
假非為擴張帝國主義而出國際戰爭。亦非日本「圖謀擴張帝國疆域戰爭。而是大東亞共榮圈內的人民，反抗英美帝國主義侵略戰爭，
共促亞洲各民族自由獨立之存亡。同時亦為整個東亞之安危。我全東亞人民自應抱定決心與共奮鬥。誓願用我熱血與身命，與日本協
力，以爭得最後勝利，並求永久和平。完成東亞各民族獨立自由之目的。出來！。
中國國民黨革命之叛徒汪精衛，與朱家驊及民衆團體聯合四出，發出通電號召救國救民之力，以響應此項新秩序。並主張結合日
本與蔣介石僞政權，組織所謂新政府，「共同反共日本同中共抗戰」，並聲言：「中國之安危與東亞之安危不可分。國家民族之
安危絕不可分」。同時日方亦積極進行誘降活動中，更變本加厲之。謂：「三十年來中日兩國國民革命之經驗，今日日方始知
道前。共黨不可輕視大東亞」。可見此等漢奸賣國賊，實是忘恩負義中國之罪人。如中國國民政府諸領袖一致，決定「萬死不屈
服於中國」，「決不接受任何條件。中國為保衛自身生存之權利」之信念。總理 孫中山先生亦謂：「我們現在共苦，將來必能同甘，我們現
在共患難，將來必能同享樂」。大家應該同心協力，犧牲一切，爭取最後勝利。相信不久，以我日本偉大之力量，必能取
勝。完成中國國民革命之目的。出來！。
戰爭爆發迄今，經歷恰以三週。文官總長岸信介氏，在貴族院及衆議院席上，宣布戰爭狀態並相關決議。聲明此次大戰，
係以佔領香港、馬來亞等地為起點，開始全面作戰。迄今滿四星期有餘。由太平洋至印度洋十餘國。近聞吳港入港。我日軍聲勢
浩蕩。陸海空，無往不利。亦指日可待。而敵方氣焰乃大為減弱。不足一週。但我方深知今後大戰艱鉅，足慰我東亞人民。共
同奮戰。東條首相以「萬死不屈，必獲勝利」。但人民作後盾江岸，以百倍於大東亞各國軍隊之人人力。也必能獲得最後勝利。獲取
以争得最後勝利。超越日本、印度百年戰爭。勝利必屬我輩。出來！。
以上三語，希望全國同胞共同奮鬥。一致努力。克服萬難。堅持到底。以争取人力物力。作日本親善關係之基礎。國
際間之地位提高。中國之自由平等四出。亦可早日實現。

中國國民黨上海特別市黨部
第四區分區駐紮辦事處工作報告

茲將本處..

自本年四月一日開始工作以來，已屆滿三個月。在此期間，本處全體同志，均能本著革命精神，努力工作，成績斐然。惟因時間短促，經驗不足，難免有諸多缺點，尚祈上級指導糾正。

一、組織方面：本區原有黨員三百餘人，經本處整理後，現已增至五百餘人。其中新發展黨員二百餘人，恢復黨籍者五十餘人。各支部均已健全，並能按時開會，討論黨務，宣傳主義。

二、宣傳方面：本處曾舉辦講演會五次，聽眾達千餘人。發行刊物三種，共計三千餘份。又於各重要街道，張貼標語，散發傳單，以擴大宣傳效果。

三、訓練方面：本處曾舉辦黨員訓練班兩期，受訓黨員一百餘人。課程包括黨義、歷史、組織、宣傳等，均由資深同志擔任講師。受訓黨員，均能領會要旨，並能應用於實際工作。

四、服務方面：本處曾協助政府，維持地方秩序，調解民間糾紛，救濟貧苦民眾。又於各學校，設立黨部，指導學生，參加革命工作。

五、經費方面：本處經費，均由上級撥發，收支清楚，帳目分明。並無濫用或浪費情事。

總之，本處工作，雖有成績，但仍有許多不足之處。今後當更加努力，以求進步。尚祈上級，多加指導，俾能完成革命任務。

此致
敬禮

中國國民黨上海特別市黨部
第四區分區駐紮辦事處
主任委員 □□□
中華民國十七年七月一日

Translation of a handbill

China's independence and liberty rely upon the
emancipation of the Orient. If China cannot obtain
independence and liberty, she will not be able to
share the responsibility of establishing a new order
in the Orient. Therefore, China's independence and
the New Order in the Orient, are closely related.
It is hoped that China and Japan will cooperate and
will thus be able to enjoy co-existence and
co-prosperity.

Shanghai Kuomintang Headquarters
(Wang Ching Wei's)
page_data.zh:
传单译文

中国的独立与自由有赖于东方的解放。如果中国不能获得独立与自由，就无法分担建立东方新秩序的责任。因此，中国的独立与东方新秩序密切相关。希望中日合作，从而能够享受共存共荣。

上海国民党总部
（汪精卫派）

page_data.en:
Translation of a handbill

We cannot allow our troops to become mercenaries
of Britain and America, and we can never allow
our people to be sacrificed in the interests of
Britain and America. We have to preserve our
national strength and resources which will be used
for the purpose of materializing the emancipation
of China and the Orient. Therefore, we must expect
that the Chungking side will arise, sever relations
with Britain and America, and participate in the
war for the emancipation of the Orient.

Shanghai Kuomintang Headquarters
(Wang Ching Wei Clique)
page_data.zh:

我们不能允许我们的军队成为英美的雇佣兵，也绝不能允许我们的人民为英美的利益而牺牲。我们必须保存国家的实力和资源，用于实现中国和东方的解放。因此，我们必须期望重庆方面奋起，与英美断绝关系，并参加东方解放战争。

上海国民党总部
（汪精卫派系）

REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SP. BR. REGISTRY
No. 1271
Date 4/6/42
Special Branch /Slddtd. File No.................... Date June 2, 1942.
SUBJECT: Details re Destruction of Britain and America Meeting sponsored by the Anti British and American Association
Due to raining, the meeting of destruction of Britain and America sponsored by the Anti British and American Association, originally to be held at the Race Course on 31-5-42, has been postponed to the afternoon of 3-6-42. The original programme will be adopted if no instructions from the Matsu Special Service Section re change of the programme.
It has been originally decided that only 5000 persons are allowed to participate in the procession but due to considerable number of participants at own initiative, it has been strictly regulated that the number of participants should not exceed 10000. The local Social Movement Association (社運会) and the Labour Cooperation Society (勞工互助會) will also participate in the meeting, without any other programme.
Submitted :-
(1) Programme of the Destruction of Britain and America Meeting by various circles of Shanghai.
(2) Names of the Chairman body and officers at the meeting.
(3) Telegram to President Wang Ching Wei and copy of the declaration of the meeting.
(4) A letter addressed to Chungking public re the meeting.
It is understood that various organizations have been notified and will send representatives along to participate in the meeting.
D. S. I.
Officer i/c Chinese Affairs, Sp. Br.
（批：Mr. Ligon. Make a report for circulation please.）
（批：Control. Informed by Louge. telephone 2/VI）
（批：Shanghai Post Division. Copy sent to O.C. (Divn.)）
（印：FILE）

特别处 /Slddtd. 档案号……………… 日期 1942年6月2日。
主题：关于反英美协会主办的摧毁英美大会详情
由于下雨，原定于1942年5月31日在跑马厅举行的由反英美协会主办的摧毁英美大会，已推迟至1942年6月3日下午。若无松井特务机关关于更改节目的指示，将采用原定节目单。
原决定仅允许5,000人参加游行，但由于自行参与者众多，现已严格规定参加人数不得超过10,000人。当地社会运动协会（社運会）和劳工互助会（勞工互助會）也将参加会议，无其他节目。
呈报：
(1) 上海各界摧毁英美大会节目单。

SECRETARIAT S.M.C.
MAY 30 1942
RECEIVED

Meeting and parade against British and American aggression.

At 9 a.m. on the 31st instant this Association will hold
a general meeting of the various circles of Shanghai, on the
Race Course grounds, Bubbling Well Road, to give publicity to
the movement for stamping out British and American aggression.
It is estimated that some ten thousand people will attend. After
the meeting the participants will parade through the city by the
following route:-

"The procession will start from the side entrance of the
Race Course, west of the New World Amusement resort, at about
11 a.m.; it will march eastward via Nanking Road then turn south
on the Bund, westward via Avenue Edward VII, and then proceed
northward into Mohawk Road for dispersion."

Fearing that the large crowd of spectators may add to the
difficulty of maintaining order, we venture to beg the Council to
instruct the Police Department to detail an adequate number of
additional police to guard the various streets through which the
procession will pass, and to temporarily close the streets to all
other traffic. Furthermore, as the schools and other organizations
which will participate in the gathering are scattered throughout
the city, we also beg the Council to kindly allow groups of persons
sent by such organizations to pass through the Settlement on the
morning of the above-mentioned date to attend the meeting. Please
note and favour with reply.

FILE

(Chopped) Chinese People's Anti-British
and Anti-American Association.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

page_data.en:
Manifesto issued by the Greater East Asia Emancipation Meeting

Three weeks have passed since Japan declared war upon Britain and the United States on December 8 for the emancipation of Greater East Asia. Yet, news of victory has been successively received, and on the 25th instant the occupation of Hongkong, one of the three bases of Britain and the United States for the invasion of East Asia, was completed. In celebration of the victories achieved by our friendly troops, we have to make clear to our fellow countrymen the following three points:-

With regard to Japan's declaration of war on Britain and the United States, Tojo, the Japanese Prime Minister, gave an explanation to the effect that "the present actions of Japan are adopted only to remove the British and American tyrannic administration so that East Asia may be able to return to its original satisfactory situation" and that "the prosperity of Japan and the rise or fall of East Asia depend entirely on this war". Togo, the Japanese Foreign Minister, stated, however, that "this war is for the emancipation of East Asia". From these statements, it may be understood that the present war between Japan on one hand and Britain and the United States on the other is not an ordinary international war fought for hegemony, nor is it a war only between Japan and Britain and the United States. It is but a war of emancipation fought by the peoples within the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere against British and American aggression. Its success or failure not only concerns the very existence of Japan but also the safety of the whole of East Asia. Hence, all people in East Asia should co-operate with Japan to struggle for victory and emancipation so as to complete our mission of East Asia for the East Asiatics.

The final aim of the Chinese national revolution and the object of national reconstruction through peace and
page_data.zh:
大东亚解放会议发布的宣言

日本为了解放大东亚，于12月8日向英美宣战，至今已过三周。然而，捷报频传，本月25日，完成了对香港——英美入侵东亚的三个基地之一——的占领。为庆祝我方友军取得的胜利，我们必须向同胞阐明以下三点：-

关于日本对英美宣战一事，日本首相东条曾解释说，“日本目前的行动仅是为了消除英美的暴政统治，使东亚能够恢复到原本令人满意的局面”，并且“日本的繁荣与东亚的兴衰完全取决于这场战争”。然而，日本外相东乡表示，“这场战争是为了东亚的解放”。从这些声明中可以理解，目前日本与英美之间的战争并非为争夺霸权而进行的普通国际战争，也不仅仅是日本与英美之间的战争。这是大东亚共荣圈内的人民反对英美侵略的解放战争。其成败不仅关系到日本的生存，也关系到整个东亚的安全。因此，东亚所有人民应与日本合作，为胜利和解放而斗争，以完成东亚人为了东亚的使命。

中国国民革命的最终目标以及通过和平与

page_data.en:
- 2 -

anti-Comintern is the eradication of the British and American
aggressive influences, and the establishment of a new order
in East Asia. Thus, following Japan's declaration of war
on Britain and the United States, the Chairman solemnly
announced that "China has decided to share the same fate
with Japan", whilst at the Japanese Diet, Togo, the Foreign
Minister, stated that "as the Chinese national revolution
during the past thirty years has now reached its objective,
this war cannot be regarded as of little significance."
Hence, the Chinese people should unite together and realize
that only with East Asia can China exist and that only with
the emancipation of East Asia can China attain freedom and
equality. They should assist the government in the
maintenance of peace and order, in the increase of production
and in the curtailment of expenditure so that China may be
a powerful ally of Japan in struggling for victory and
attaining the objective of the Chinese national revolution.

Though it is only three weeks since the outbreak
of the war, our friendly troops have shown their great power.
The Asiatic Fleets of Britain and the United States were
annihilated during the sea battles at Hawaii and Malaya, and
the fall of Kowloon was followed by the occupation of Hongkong.
It must be a cheering that from the hands of Britain and
the United States our friendly troops have recovered
Hongkong, which has been taken out of the hands of our
country for one hundred years since the Nanking Treaty. The
Japanese forces are now continuously advancing. The
occupation of Manila and Singapore are imminent. This shows
that Britain and the United States are even too weak for a
single engagement. The great success of our friendly
troops has added glory to the peoples of East Asia. Though
Britain and the United States are making use of deceitful
propaganda to their people stating that with their great
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

反共实现国家重建的目的，是根除英美的侵略影响，并在东亚建立新秩序。因此，继日本对英美宣战之后，主席庄严宣布“中国决定与日本同命运”，而在日本帝国议会中，外相东乡表示，“鉴于过去三十年的中国国民革命现已达到其目标，这场战争不能被视作无足轻重。”因此，中国人民应团结起来，认识到只有依托东亚，中国才能存在；只有实现东亚的解放，中国才能获得自由和平等。他们应协助政府维护治安、增加生产并削减开支，使中国成为日本争取胜利和实现中国国民革命目标的有力盟友。

虽然战争爆发仅三周，但我方友军已显示出强大的力量。英美亚洲舰队在夏威夷和马来亚的海战中被歼灭，九龙失守后紧接着香港被占领。令人振奋的是，我方友军从英美手中收复了自《南京条约》签订以来脱离我国版图一百年的香港。日军目前正在持续推进。马尼拉和新加坡的陷落指日可待。这表明英美甚至无力进行单次交战。我方友军的巨大成功为东亚人民增添了荣耀。尽管英美对其民众使用欺骗性宣传，声称凭借其巨大的

page_data.en:
- 3 -

resources they will attain victory, it must be understood
that Greater East Asia has limitless man-power and natural
resources. With this man-power and resources to assist
Japan, the victory certainly must be ours, though the war may
last a hundred years.
It is hoped that all our fellow countrymen will make
themselves clear on the above three points and offer all our
man-power and natural resources to back up Japan in her war
with Britain and the United States so that the emancipation of
East Asia and China's freedom and equality may be attained at
an early date.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

资源他们将取得胜利，但必须明白，大东亚拥有无限的人力和自然资源。凭借这些人力和资源援助日本，即使战争持续百年，胜利也必然属于我们。
希望全体同胞认清上述三点，贡献所有的人力和自然资源，支持日本对英美的战争，以便早日实现东亚的解放以及中国的自由和平等。

Gordon Road Police Station. File No. Date May 12th, 1942.
SUBJECT: Suspicious movement of goods.
Sir,
At 4.30 p.m. 9-5-42 C.P.C.s 2492 & 136 who were on duty on Haiphong Road, observed a large number of packages being removed from No.7 Warehouse, No.18 Chiang Ka Loong, Haiphong Road, to a M/Truck Lic. No. S.M.C. 11145 , F.M.C. No.3546. They approached the vehicle but were unable to ascertain what the cargo consisted of and asked for a permit but none could be produced. In view of this C.P.C.2492 ordered the truck driver to proceed to Gordon Road Police Station. On arriving at the Station Gate the driver disregarded Police instructions to stop and continued to Wuting Road. At this point the C.P.C. alighted and ordered the Chauffeur to return to the Station. He refused to do so and drove away.
The fact that the vehicle was driven away is suspicious and leads one to believe that the cargo was restricted and should only be moved on the authority of a permit.
The M/Truck is registered with the "Sung Nyi" Chemical Works, Rue Massenet.

先生，
1942年5月9日下午4时30分，在海防路执勤的中国巡捕 2492号和136号，观察到大量包裹正从海防路江家弄18号第7仓库搬运至一辆牌照号为 S.M.C. 11145、F.M.C. 3546 的机动卡车。他们走近车辆，但无法查明货物内容，并要求出示许可证，但对方未能出示。鉴于此情况，中国巡捕2492号命令卡车司机前往戈登路警署。到达警署大门时，司机无视警察停车指令，继续驶往武定路。此时，该中国巡捕下车，命令司机返回警署。司机拒绝服从并驾车离去。

at Gordon Rd St'n on the 10-5-42.......................and inspected by P.S.I. Chu Yang Sung

Between 3p.m. and 7p.m. 9-5-42, we were on duty at No. 372
Haiphong Road. At 4.10p.m. same date, a green coloured motor
truck, S.M.C. Lic. No. 11145, F.M.C. Lic. No. 3546, with
"Vit-Spermain" and "Halison" advertisements on the driver's cabin,
was stationary opposite our post. At 4.30p.m. same date, more
than 30 bales of goods were loaded onto the truck whereupon we
approached the truck enquiring if there was a permit; and what
kind of goods they were. A person then told us that they were
borax and that there was no permit or delivery order. As we
could not distinguish the goods, C.P.C. 2492 escorted the truck
to the station while C.P.C. 136 remained at the post. On
arriving at the station gate, the chauffeur disregarded the
police instructions, drove on at a high speed and stopped at the
corner of Wuting Road. C.P.C. 2492 on alighting from the truck
but holding same with his hand, ordered the chauffeur to turn
round but the chauffeur drove off in a southerly direction. C.P.C.
2492 then reported the above occurrence to the station. The goods
were removed out from No. 7 warehouse of the Ming Sung Trading Co.,
No. 18., Chiang Ka Loong, Haiphong Rd.
(Sgd) C.P.C's 2492, 136.

1942年5月9日下午3时至7时之间，我们在海防路372号执勤。同日午后4时10分，一辆绿色机动卡车（S.M.C. 牌照号 11145，F.M.C. 牌照号 3546），驾驶室上贴有“Vit-Spermain”和“Halison”广告，停在我们岗哨对面。同日午后4时30分，三十多包货物被装上卡车，于是我们走近卡车，询问是否有许可证以及货物种类。当时有人告诉我们那是硼砂，并且没有许可证或提货单。由于我们无法辨别货物，中国巡捕2492号护送卡车前往警署，而中国巡捕136号留在岗哨。到达警署大门时，司机无视警察指令，高速继续行驶，并在武定路拐角处停下。中国巡捕2492号下车，手扶车辆，命令司机掉头，但司机向南方向驾车离去。随后，中国巡捕2492号向警署报告了上述情况。货物是从海防路江家弄18号明松贸易公司（Ming Sung Trading Co.）的第7仓库搬出的。

SUBJECT:
Programme of the meeting
The programme of the meeting includes the
following:-
(a) Singing of the national songs of China and
Japan.
(b) Keeping silence in honour of the war dead.
(c) Speeches by members of the Presidium, officials,
guests, and representatives of public bodies
etc.
(d) Discussion on a proposal to address an open
letter to the people under the Chungking regime
advising them to give up pro-British and pro-
American ideas and to assist in the construction
of a Greater Asia.
(e) Singing of a song entitled "The March of the
United Peoples of the Great East Asia."
(f) Shouting of slogans as follows:-
"Smash British and American invasion!"
"Establish an Asia for Asiatics! "
"Long live the Republic of China!"
Procession after the conclusion of the meeting
After the conclusion of the meeting, the
participants will hold a procession along the
following route:-
From the Race Course; proceeding eastward along
Nanking Road, turning southward into the Bund and
then westward into Avenue Edward VII. Having
proceeded westward along Avenue Edward VII to the
corner of Rue Montigny, the procession will disperse
near the Great World Amusement Resort.
The procession will consist of several musical bands,
about 10 decorated trolley buses and a similar
number of decorated motor trucks.

大会议程
大会议程包括以下内容：-
(a) 奏唱中国与日本国歌。
(b) 为战争死难者默哀。
(c) 主席团成员、官员、宾客及各公共团体代表等发表演讲。
(d) 讨论一项提案，即向重庆政权治下民众发表公开信，劝其放弃亲英亲美思想，协助建设大亚洲。
(e) 合唱题为《大东亚联合民族进行曲》的歌曲。
(f) 高呼如下口号：-
“粉碎英美侵略！”
“建立亚洲人的亚洲！”
“中华民国万岁！”
会后游行
会议结束后，参与者将沿以下路线举行游行：-
从跑马厅出发；沿南京路向东行进，向南转入外滩，再向西转入爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）。沿爱多亚路向西行至孟斗班路（Rue Montigny）转角处，队伍将在大世界游乐场附近解散。
游行队伍将由数个乐队、约10辆装饰过的电车以及数量相当的装饰过的卡车组成。

Shanghai, 25th May, 1942.

The Secretary,
The Anti-Allied Association,
Shanghai.

Sir,
In answer to your letter of 23rd inst. I must
inform you that this Club does not own the ground
inside the Race Course which is at present under
the control of N. I. J. M. Military Forces which also
controls admission to the ground by the Iseng-Pei
or East Entrance Gates which is the Entrance for
the Public.
This Club is a purely private and International
Club and the Club's Enclosures are private; the Gates
on the Bubbling Well and Mohawk Roads are private
entrances and those on the Bubbling Well Road have
been closed by order of N. I. J. M. Military Forces.
With reference to use of ground inside the Race
Course applications for such should be addressed to:-
Mr. T. W. R. Wilson,
Secretary,
Committee of Management,
Recreation Ground within the Race Course,
His Office address is -
c/o Public Works Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council.
(Tel. No. 13480).

In view of the control of activities on the Recrea-
tion Ground and Race Course being in the hands of N. I. J. M.
Military Forces it might be advisable for you to consult
N. I. J. M. Military Headquarters and arrange details for
Sunday, 31st May, 1942; the Military will no doubt, as
in the past, then approach this Club, and if they do so,
they will be accorded full assistance and co-operation as
on previous occasions.
The Shanghai Municipal Police should also be notified
so that they can take precautions to reduce possibility of
damages to property etc.
Yours faithfully,

T. SUGAWA
Representative
THE SHANGHAI HUNG CHAN CORPORATION LTD.
Administrators/Controllers of
The Shanghai Race Course & Club.

A. R. OLSEN,
Secretary.

3. Essential materials hiding and smuggling.

Since the Imperial forces entered the Settlement
after the outbreak of the Great East Asia War, peace and good
order have been effectively maintained, to the benefit of
multitudes of people. Gratitude is due to the Imperial forces.
According to a proclamation issued by the Imperial
forces, foodstuffs, cotton fabrics, and metals such as tin,
copper, zinc, aluminium and lead, must be registered and
submitted to control. Secret removal of these commodities
is prohibited on penalty of immediate confiscation.
Some bad characters are now offering high prices for
the purchase of copper, tin, zinc and aluminium. The stocks
purchased are so plentiful as to escape attention and smuggled
out of the Settlement. Otherwise, they are hidden underground
for future supply to the British and Americans.
I understand that these metals are essential war
materials. If the Imperial forces do not issue a further
proclamation strictly prohibiting the sale and removal of
such metals, they will suffer serious loss. It is hoped
that the Imperial forces will quickly publish a Proclamation
to prohibit the purchase and sale of copper and tin. Violation
of the stipulations of the Proclamation will render the stocks
liable to confiscation. This matter should also be brought
to the attention of the Supreme Commander of the Imperial
forces of Great Japan.

(Signed) Seng Yu-chia,
A Chinese student.

Prohibition of removal may also be announced in
newspapers.

Received for translation p.m. 21st April (1942.)
C. Kliene

3. 重要物资的藏匿与走私。

自大东亚战争爆发后帝国军队进入租界以来，和平与良好秩序得到有效维持，造福广大民众。对此应向帝国军队表示感谢。
根据帝国军队发布的公告，食品、棉织品以及锡、铜、锌、铝和铅等金属必须登记并接受管制。禁止秘密转移这些商品，违者立即没收。
一些不良分子现在出高价收购铜、锡、锌和铝。收购的存货数量庞大，足以避开注意并被走私出租界。否则，它们被埋藏在地下，以备将来供应给英美人士。
本人获悉这些金属是重要的战争物资。如果帝国军队不发布进一步公告严格禁止此类金属的销售和转移，他们将遭受严重损失。希望帝国军队迅速发布公告，禁止买卖铜和锡。违反公告规定将使存货面临没收风险。此事也应提请大日本帝国军队最高指挥官注意。

（签名）Seng Yu-chia,
一名中国学生。

禁止转移的规定也可在报纸上公布。

自大东亚战争爆发后帝国军队进入租界以来；和平与良好秩序得到有效维持，造福广大民众。对此应向帝国军队表示感谢。

根据帝国军队发布的公告，食品、棉织品以及锡、
铜、锌、铝和铅等金属必须登记并接受管制。禁止秘密转移这些商品，违者立即没收。

一些不良分子现在出高价收购铜、锡、锌和铝。收购的存货包装严密以避开注意，并被走私出租界。否则，它们被埋藏在地下，以备将来供应给英美人士。

本人获悉这些金属是重要的战争物资。如果帝国军队不发布进一步公告严格禁止此类金属的销售和转移，他们将遭受严重损失。希望帝国军队迅速发布公告，禁止买卖铜和锡。违反公告规定将使存货面临没收风险。此事也应提请大日本帝国军队最高指挥官注意。

（签名）Seng Yu-chia,
一名中国学生。

附言：禁止转移的规定也可在报纸上公布。

（注：于1942年4月21日下午收到以供翻译。）
（印：上海公共租界工部局翻译办公室 1942年4月21日）
C. Kliene.

S. 1. Special Branch File No. Date March 11, 1942.
SUBJECT: "East Asia Security Day" - 8th of every month.
It was decided at a meeting of the Central Political Committee of the Nanking Government that with effect from March 8th, 1942, the eighth of every month will be observed as the "East Asia Security Day".
Articles and other items relating to this subject will, on the day, be published in all newspapers and otherwise announced for the purpose of propaganda. In order to express the common faith of Chinese people with friendly nations, all amusement resorts, except cinemas, will cease operating on this day, and no parties will be held.
Acting on the orders of the Nanking Government, Mayor Chen Kung Po has instructed all official organs under the control of the Shanghai City Government to observe "East Asia Security Day".
Dan hien pit

9 MAR. 1942

SHANGHAI TIMES.

Nanking Government To Mark
Eighth Of Every Month

(Domei)
NANKING, March 8.—For the purpose of commemorating the outbreak of the Greater East Asia War on December 8 last year and for stirring up the Chinese people to further co-operate in the gigantic task of constructing new East Asia for the peoples of East Asia, the Nanking Government decided to observe the "Toa Hoei Kinenbi," (East Asia Security Day) on the eighth of every month, starting today.
President Wang Ching-wei in a statement said the security of East Asia which had been the common faith of all peoples in East Asia, had now become the common goal and watchword of the Greater East Asia War.
He said that those who co-operate in the achievement of this goal would be friends of East Asia, while those who do not co-operate would be enemies of East Asia.
"I urge you people of China to redouble your efforts to share difficulties in order to invite perpetual peace and security in East Asia," he declared.

1942年3月9日

《上海泰晤士报》。

南京政府将纪念
每月八日

（同盟社）
南京，3月8日电。— 为纪念去年12月8日大东亚战争的爆发，并激励中国人民进一步合作，完成为东亚人民建设新东亚的巨大任务，南京政府决定从今天起，将每月8日定为“大东亚纪念日”（东洋会纪念日，即大东亚保安日）。
汪精卫主席在声明中表示，东亚安全一直是东亚各国人民的共同信念，如今已成为大东亚战争的共同目标和口号。
他说，那些为实现这一目标而合作的人将是东亚的朋友，而那些不合作的人将是东亚的敌人。
“我敦促中国人民加倍努力，共担困难，以谋求东亚的永久和平与安全，”他宣称。

page_data.en:
DATES FOR THE CELEBRATION OF THE FALL OF SINGAPORE.

February 18 (1st Day)

1) Affixing slogans.
2) Scattering of handbills (Employees of the Post
Office will be utilized).
3) Raising of national flags.
4) Cloth banners will be hung across various streets.
5) Mayor Chen Kung Po will broadcast over the Greater
Shanghai Broadcasting Station.
6) Decorated tramcars will be run on February 18 and
19.
7) Erecting of arches.
8) Letting off fireworks at the Race Course between
7 p.m. and 8 p.m.
9) A grand meeting of representatives of various bodies
will be held at 2 p.m. in the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce. About 5,000 persons will attend the
meeting.

February 19 (2nd Day): Street Propaganda Day

1) From 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. four street mobile lecture
vehicles will be sent to distribute handbills and
to deliver lectures in the two Foreign Settlements.
One vehicle will operate in the International
Settlement and the remaining three in the French
Concession. The route to be taken will be the
same as mentioned according to paragraph 9 in the
previous report forwarded on February 10.
page_data.zh:
庆祝新加坡陷落之日程安排。

2月18日（第一天）

1) 张贴标语。
2) 散发传单（将利用邮局职员）。
3) 悬挂国旗。
4) 在各街道悬挂布制横幅。
5) 市长陈公博将在大上海广播电台广播。
6) 2月18日和19日将有装饰过的电车运行。
7) 搭建牌坊。
8) 晚上7时至8时在跑马厅燃放烟花。
9) 下午2时将在上海总商会举行各界代表盛大集会。预计约有5,000人出席。

2月19日（第二天）：街头宣传日

1) 上午10时至下午5时，四辆街头流动宣传车将前往两个外国租界分发传单并进行演讲。一辆车在国际租界活动，其余三辆在法租界活动。路线与2月10日呈送的前一份报告第9段所述相同。

page_data.en:
2) 50 street lecture corps consisting of 5 persons
each will set out for various streets and public
places to give lectures at 1 p.m. 30 of the
corps will set out in the International Settlement.
15 in the French Concession and 5 in Nantao. Each
of these corps will stop at one point for about
10 minutes.
3) From 7.30 p.m. to 8 p.m., a film of the Great East
Asia War will be screened at the Race Course. In
case of inclement weather, it will be shown in the
building of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
Necessary police protection is desired.
4) A movement to secure signatures will be started on
the same day. Signatures will be given voluntarily.
During the movement of the past two weeks, signatures
of some 1,200,000 persons will be secured.
5) Mr. Chow Fu Hai or Mr. Ting Muh Tsung will broadcast
over the Greater Shanghai Broadcasting Station
between 9 p.m. and 9.30 p.m.
6) There will be a procession of decorated tramcars.

February 20 (3rd Day): Sino-Japanese Lien Hwen Day

1) At noon, a Sino-Japanese Lien Hwen Meeting will be
held on the 14th floor of the Park Hotel, at which
well-known persons and representatives of public
bodies will attend to entertain officers of various
organs of the friendly nation.
2) Various organizations and well-known persons will
jointly send a telegram of respect to President
Wang Ching Wei and a telegram of congratulation
page_data.zh:
2) 由5人组成的50个街头宣讲队将于下午1时出发，前往各街道和公共场所进行演讲。其中30个队在国际租界出发，15个队在法租界，5个队在南市。每个宣讲队将在一个地点停留约10分钟。
3) 晚上7时30分至8时，将在跑马厅放映大东亚战争电影。如遇恶劣天气，改在上海总商会大楼内放映。需要必要的警力保护。
4) 同日将发起签名运动。签名基于自愿原则。在过去两周的运动中，已征集到约1,200,000人的签名。
5) 周佛海先生或丁默邨先生将于晚上9时至9时30分在大上海广播电台广播。
6) 将有装饰过的电车游行。

2月20日（第三天）：中日联欢日

1) 中午，将在国际饭店十四楼举行中日联欢会，知名人士及各团体代表将出席，宴请友邦各机关官员。
2) 各组织和知名人士将联名向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向日本首相、陆军省、海军省、日本派遣军总部及日本大使馆发送贺电

page_data.en:
to the Japanese Prime Minister, the Ministry of Army,
the Ministry of Navy, the Japanese Expeditionary
Forces Headquarters and the Japanese Embassy.
3) A Government official or a well-known person of the
community will be invited to speak over the Greater
Shanghai Broadcasting Station between 9 p.m. and
9.30 p.m.
4) Well-known persons will write articles to be
published in the special supplements and will also
send a joint circular telegram to Chungking.

February 21 (4th Day)

1) A People's Congratulatory Meeting will be held in
the Shanghai Race Course at 2 p.m. About 150,000
persons will attend the meeting.
2) At about 3.30 p.m. after the People's Congratulatory
Meeting, a Civil Parade will proceed along the route
previously fixed. Ten Batches, each comprising 1,000
persons, will participate in the Parade. After the
first batch leaves the Race Course, the remaining
batches will follow one after another at an interval
of 5 minutes. When proceeding along the streets,
persons in the batches will scatter handbills containing
slogans.
140,000 out of the 150,000 persons attending the People's
Congratulatory Meeting will disperse after the last
batch has left the Race Course.
Lieut.-General Sawada and some 30 other officers will
inspect the parade from the 14th floor of the Park Hotel.
The Parade will end at 6 or 7 p.m.
page_data.zh:
3) 将邀请政府官员或社会知名人士于晚上9时至9时30分在大上海广播电台发表讲话。
4) 知名人士将撰写文章刊登在特刊上，并将联名向重庆发送通电。

2月21日（第四天）

1) 下午2时将在上海跑马厅举行民众庆祝大会。预计约有150,000人出席。
2) 民众庆祝大会结束后，约下午3时30分，市民游行队伍将沿既定路线行进。共有十批队伍参加游行，每批1,000人。第一批队伍离开跑马厅后，其余批次每隔5分钟依次跟进。在街道行进过程中，队伍成员将散发含有标语的传单。
参加民众庆祝大会的150,000人中，有140,000人将在最后一批队伍离开跑马厅后疏散。
泽田中将及其他约30名军官将从国际饭店十四楼检阅游行队伍。
游行将于下午6时或7时结束。

page_data.en:
February 22 (5th Day): Propaganda Day By Agriculturists
1) Meeting of agriculturists will be held in Pootung at
10 a.m.
2) The seven districts of Shanghai will each simultaneously
hold a mass meeting.
3) The meeting of representatives of agriculturists will
select representatives to offer congratulations to the
superior officers of the friendly nation.
4) The mass meeting of each district will select represen-
tatives to offer congratulations to the superior
officers of the friendly nation.
5) Agricultural organizations and public bodies of each
district will each send a telegram of respect to
President Wang Ching-wei and offer congratulations to
the friendly nation.
6) Village lecturing corps will be formed to undertake
propaganda in villages at 2 p.m.

February 23 (6th Day): Propaganda Day of Labour Circle
1) Meeting of representatives of workers will be held at
the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce at 10 a.m.
2) Meeting will select representatives to tender
congratulations to the superior officers of the friendly
nation.
3) Each of the workers' bodies will send a telegram of
respect to President Wang Ching-wei and will also pay
respects to the competent organs of the friendly nation.
4) At 6 p.m. moving pictures of the Great East Asia War
will be shown for the benefit of workers. It will be
held at the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce.
page_data.zh:
2月22日（第五天）：农业界宣传日
1) 上午10时在浦东举行农民大会。
2) 上海七个区将同时举行群众大会。
3) 农民代表会议将选出代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
4) 各区群众大会将选出代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
5) 各区农业组织和公共团体将分别向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向友邦致贺。
6) 下午2时将组建乡村宣讲队，在乡村开展宣传工作。

2月23日（第六天）：劳工界宣传日
1) 上午10时在上海总商会举行工人代表会议。
2) 会议将选出代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
3) 各工人团体将向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向友邦主管机关致意。
4) 下午6时将为工人放映大东亚战争电影。地点在上海总商会。

page_data.en:
7th Day : Commercial Circles' Propaganda Day 24/2/42.
1) Meeting of representatives of commercial circles to
be held at 10 a.m. in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
2) Representatives to be elected at the meeting to offer
congratulations to officials of the friendly nation.
3) All commercial public bodies should send a telegram
of respect and congratulations to President Wang Ching
Wei and to friendly organizations.
4) Labourers' and Merchants' Lien Hwen Association will
give a dinner party to officials of the Nanking
Government and the friendly nation at 5 p.m. in the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce.

8th Day : Students' Propaganda Day 25/2/42.
1) At 10 a.m. a meeting of students' representatives
will be held in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
2) At the meeting, representatives will be elected to
pay respects to officials of the friendly nation.
2) All youths' and students' public bodies will send
telegrams of respect and congratulations to President
Wang Ching Wei and to the organizations of the
friendly nation.
4) Between 2 and 6 p.m. football and basketball matches
will be played at the Canidrome. 20,000 people are
expected to attend. The proceeds from the admission
tickets will be used to relieve refugees in the South
Sea Islands.

9th Day : Religious Circles' Propaganda Day 26/2/42
1) A meeting of representatives of religious circles will
be held at 10 a.m. in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
page_data.zh:
第七天：商业界宣传日 42年2月24日。
1) 上午10时在上海总商会举行商界代表会议。
2) 会议将选举代表，向友邦官员致贺。
3) 所有商业公共团体应向汪精卫主席及友邦组织发送致敬和祝贺电。
4) 劳商联欢协会将于下午5时在上海总商会设宴招待南京政府及友邦官员。

第八天：学生界宣传日 42年2月25日。
1) 上午10时在上海总商会举行学生代表会议。
2) 会议将选举代表，向友邦官员致意。
2) [原文编号重复] 所有青年和学生公共团体应向汪精卫主席及友邦组织发送致敬和祝贺电。
4) 下午2时至6时将在逸园（Canidrome）举行足球和篮球比赛。预计有20,000人出席。门票收入将用于救济南洋群岛难民。

第九天：宗教界宣传日 42年2月26日
1) 上午10时在上海总商会举行宗教界代表会议。

page_data.en:
2) At the meeting, representatives will be elected to pay
respects to officials of the friendly nation.
3) All educational bodies will send a telegram of respect
and congratulations to President Wang Ching Wei and to
organizations of the friendly nation.
4) Notables of educational circles will be invited to
speak over the Greater Shanghai Radio Station.

10th Day : Cultural Circles' Propaganda Day 27/2/42
1) A meeting of representatives of newspapers, news
agencies and cultural bodies will be held at 10 a.m.
in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
2) At the meeting, representatives will be elected to
offer congratulations to the officials of the friendly
nation.
3) All cultural bodies, newspapers and news agencies will
send a telegram of respect to President Wang Ching Wei
and to organizations of the Friendly nation.
4) At 2 p.m. a tea party to discuss the emancipation of
the South Sea Islands will be held in the Hotel Pacific.

nation.

congratulations to President Wang Ching Wei and to
organizations of the friendly nation.

2) 会议将选举代表，向友邦官员致意。

4) 下午2时将在太平洋饭店举行茶话会，讨论南洋群岛解放问题。

4) 晚上9时至9时30分将通过大上海广播电台播放歌曲。

page_data.en:
12th Day : Citizens' Propagating Day 1/3/42
1) Meeting of representatives of citizens to be held at
the Chinese Chamber of Commerce at 10 a.m.
2) Meeting to detail representatives to offer congrat-
ulations to high officials of the friendly nation.
3) Various Citizens' Federations to dispatch telegrams
of respect to President Wang Ching Wei and telegrams
of congratulations to organizations of the friendly
nation.
4) To promote a movement for citizens to make contri-
butions for the comfort of the officers and men at
the front engaged in the war for the emancipation of
Great Asia.
page_data.zh:

1) 上午10时在上海总商会举行市民代表会议。
2) 会议将指派代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
3) 各市民联合会应向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向友邦组织发送祝贺电。
4) 推动市民捐款运动，以慰劳从事大亚洲解放战争的 frontline 官兵。

page_data.en:
13th Day : Propagating Days of the Special Bodies 2/3/42
1) At 10 a.m. representatives of various countrymen's
associations and special bodies will hold a meeting.
2) The meeting will appoint delegates to tender con-
gratulations to officers of the friendly army.
3) Various special bodies will send a telegram of respect
to President Wang Ching-wei and telegrams of congrat-

4) From 2 p.m. to stage boxing at the Chamber of Commerce.
5) Meeting of Asiatic People will be held on the 13th
floor, Park Hotel.

page_data.en:
Plan To Celebrate The Fall Of Singapore

I. Purpose
Mainly the City Government and the Social
Movement Direction Committee will be responsible
for the carrying out of a propaganda campaign
among the Chinese people by holding a People's
Congratulatory Meeting, flag paraded, and lecture-
meetings, scattering handbills and running decorated
tramcars etc.

II. Events.
1 ) People's Congratulatory Meeting
a.- Time: From 2 p.m. on the day of the entry
into Singapore.
b.- Place: Shanghai Race Course.
c.- Number of attendants: From 150,000 to 200,000
persons.

2 ) Civil parade
a.- Time: After the People's Congratulatory Meeting.
B.- Route: From Shanghai Race Course via Bubbling
Well Road, Nanking Road, the Bund, Rue
du Consulate, Montigny Road, the Great
World, Avenue Edward VII and Mohawk Road
to Shanghai Race Course.
(The parade will disperse at the Race Course)

3 ) Letting off of fireworks
a.- Time: At 6 p.m.
b.- Place: In the Shanghai Race Course.

4 ) Hoisting of national flags
All Chinese governmental offices, shops and
residences will hoist national flags.

5 ) Floating of 10 balloons
Place: The Bund, Shanghai Race Course, the City Cham-
ber of Commerce, Bubbling Well Road, Shanghai
page_data.zh:
庆祝新加坡陷落计划

一、目的
主要由市政府和社会运动指导委员会负责，通过举行民众庆祝大会、旗帜游行、演讲会、散发传单以及运行装饰电车等方式，在中国民众中开展宣传活动。

二、活动。
1) 民众庆祝大会
a.- 时间：进入新加坡当日下午2时起。
b.- 地点：上海跑马厅。
c.- 参加人数：15万至20万人。

2) 市民游行
a.- 时间：民众庆祝大会之后。
B.- 路线：从上海跑马厅出发，经静安寺路、南京路、外滩、领事馆路、蒙梯尼路（Montigny Road）、大世界、爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）和莫霍克路（Mohawk Road）返回上海跑马厅。
（游行队伍在跑马厅解散）

3) 燃放烟花
a.- 时间：下午6时。
b.- 地点：上海跑马厅内。

4) 悬挂国旗
所有中国政府机关、商店和住宅均须悬挂国旗。

5) 放飞10只气球
地点：外滩、上海跑马厅、市总商会、静安寺路、上海

Translation of letter from the Shanghai Special
Municipality Citizens' Preparatory Committee to
Celebrate Emancipation of South Seas, dated
Feb. 14, 1942.

Special Branch,
S. M. P.

Gentlemen,

We have to inform you that after the occupation of
Singapore by the Japanese soldiers we are going to hold a
celebration meeting in the Race Course on Bubbling Well Road.
About 200,000 persons are expected to attend the meeting to
be followed by a procession.

You are requested to detail large number of detectives
and policemen to the scene to maintain order.

We will not fail to inform you of the exact time and
date of the meeting 24 hours in advance.

Roads to be traversed by the processionists are:
Bubbling Well, Nanking Roads, The Bund, Avenue Edward VII,
Rue du Consulate, Yu Ya Ching Road, Race Course Road, and
Mohawk Road.

Misc.162/42
23-2-42.
SPP 9 1271 / 3 42

Suspected attempt to obtain property
sealed by the Naval Landing Party.

Sir,
At 1.30p.m. 23-2-42 Mr. H.J. Moysey, Director of
H.J. Moysey, & Co. Ltd 452 Kiangse Road came to the
station and reported the following:-
Some two weeks ago his premises were sealed by the
Japanese Naval Landing Party, one by the name of Iseri
attached to the Pay Master's Office, 610 Broadway was
in charge of the sealing process.
Yesterday, 27-2-42, Iseri rang up Moysey and asked
him to go and see him in connection with the un-sealing
of his premises. In compliance with this request
Moysey went to see Iseri at about 9.30 this morning,
23-2-42, at 610 Broadway and after discussing the
business to hand Moysey left the premises at about
10.15and returned to his home at 170/3 Route Ghisi, F.C.
When he returned home he was informed that a telephone
message had been received at about 10.15 instructing him
to go to his office at 2p.m. today as the Naval Landing
Party were going to move some electrical machinery.
Moysey suspect that something was wrong as he had not
long ago left Iseri who had made no mention of anything
being done today. He rang up Iseri and was informed
by him that no such instructions had been issued.
J.P.S. 78C and C.D.S. 208 attended and on arrival
at 452 Kiangse Road found members of the Gendarmerie
and Naval Landing Party already there. It was ascer-
tained that they wished to make a further examination of
the sealed property.

RM
Sen.Det.1/c.
Associate D. I.

涉嫌企图获取被海军陆战队查封的财产。

先生：
1942年2月23日下午1时30分，江西路452号 H.J. Moysey & Co. Ltd 董事 H.J. Moysey 先生来到警局报案，内容如下：
约两周前，他的场所被日本海军陆战队查封，隶属于主计长办公室、百老汇路610号的一名名为 Iseri 的人员负责查封工作。
昨天，1942年2月27日（注：原文日期逻辑有误，前文为23日，此处写27日，依原文翻译），Iseri 打电话给 Moysey，要求他就解除其场所查封一事去见他。应此要求，Moysey 于今天上午（1942年2月23日）9时30分左右前往百老汇路610号会见 Iseri，在商讨完手头事务后，Moysey 于10时15分左右离开该处，返回其位于法租界祁齐路170/3号的家中。
当他回到家时，被告知约在10时15分收到一条电话留言，指示他于今天下午2时前往办公室，因为海军陆战队将要搬运一些电气机械。
Moysey 怀疑其中有诈，因为他不久前才离开 Iseri，而 Iseri 并未提及今天有任何行动。他打电话给 Iseri，Iseri 告知他并未发出此类指示。
警员 J.P.S. 78C 和 C.D.S. 208 到场，在抵达江西路452号时，发现宪兵队和海军陆战队成员已经在那里。经查明，他们希望对已查封的财产进行进一步检查。

With reference to my Memo of February 18, 1942
re "Celebrations of fall of Singapore" the following
additional information is now available regarding the
Civil Parade to be held on the Race Course at 2 p.m.
Monday February 23, instead of February 21 as originally scheduled.

The crowd will start to enter at 1 p.m. Entrance
will be by the main gates opposite Myburgh Road only.
Mohawk Road gates will be closed. The procession will
leave by the Lung Fei gate and traverse the route
given in my Memo of February 18, to Mohawk and Race
Course Roads where it will disperse. The estimated
time on route is about 2 hours.

Police will be posted at all intersections en
route and every possible precaution must be taken to
prevent an incident. All avenues of escape must be
blocked.

Police will be posted at intervals round the bamboo fence of the Race Course on Race Course Road and
Mohawk Road. One Reserve Unit will take up position
inside the main entrance (near the clock tower) at 1 p.m.
and will remain until the grounds are cleared. One
Reserve Unit will be at the disposal of the D.O. "A" at
Louza Station from 1 p.m. and one Reserve Unit will
stand by at Gordon Road.

D.O. "A" will post all available C.P.C.s and
Chinese detectives inside the grounds. It is imperative
that Chinese detectives carry their Warrant Cards with
them as a means of identification as all persons entering
the grounds will be searched by the sponsors of the
Parade. The following S.M.P. (Specials) will report for
duty at the Station mentioned at 1 p.m. on the day of
the Parade.

关于我1942年2月18日有关“庆祝新加坡陷落”的备忘录，现就原定于2月21日、现改期至2月23日（星期一）下午2时在跑马厅举行的民间游行，提供以下补充信息。

人群将于下午1时开始入场。仅允许通过面对迈尔西爱路（Myburgh Road）的正门进入。莫霍克路（Mohawk Road）大门将关闭。游行队伍将从龙飞门离开，并按照我2月18日备忘录中所述的路线行进，至莫霍克路和跑马厅路后解散。预计沿途耗时约2小时。

警察将部署在沿途所有交叉路口，必须采取一切可能的预防措施以防止发生事故。所有逃生通道必须封锁。

警察将间隔部署在跑马厅路及莫霍克路跑马厅的竹篱笆周围。一支后备队将于下午1时在正门内（靠近钟楼处）就位，并停留至场地清空。一支后备队自下午1时起听候“A”区主管在老闸捕房调遣，另一支后备队在戈登路待命。

“A”区主管将把所有可用的中央巡逻车（C.P.C.s）和华人侦探部署在场地内。华人侦探必须随身携带委任证作为身份证明，因为所有进入场地的人员都将受到游行主办方的搜查。下列上海公共租界工部局警务处（特别警员）将于游行当日下午1时在指定捕房报到执勤。

February 18, 1942.

Reference the Memorandum dated February 10, 1942 regarding
"Celebrations of Fall of Singapore", a Civil parade which will
be attended by approximately 50,000 people will be held in the
Race Course at 2 p.m. on February 21st. After the parade
10,000 of the participants will leave the Race Course in batches
of 1,000 each at 5 minutes interval, and proceed via Bubbling
Well Road, Nanking Road, The Bund, Avenue Edward VII, Rue du
Consulat, Rue de Montigny, Avenue Edward VII, to Mohawk Road,
where it will disperse. Divisional Officers will instruct the
Officers in charge to take all possible precautions along the
line of route. Every available policeman will be on duty, and
at intersections onlookers should be kept back to a distance of
100 yards from the line of procession.

The celebrations in connection with the fall of Singapore
will extend over a period of 15 days, starting from February 18,
1942. A comprehensive list of these celebrations will be issued
later. Pending the issue of this list the following is a pro-
gramme to be observed on the second day of the celebrations,
February 19, 1942.

Speeches will be delivered at various points in the
Settlement, chiefly South of the Creek, from 3 motor cars
and leaflets will be distributed.

30 parties, each consisting of 5 men, will deliver
speeches at various points in the Settlement.

Cinematograph exhibitions of war pictures will be
held on the Race Course from 7 to 8 p.m. If the weather
is wet the display will take place in the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce.

Books will be placed at different points in the Settle-
ment in which members of the Chinese population will be
invited to record their adherence to The Social Movement in
celebrations of the fall of Singapore.

Decorated street cars operating on the streets on
February 18 will continue to operate throughout the day of
February 19.

Divisional Officers will adopt every possible precaution to
prevent an incident and will use their men to the fullest
advantage.

SD. H. Robertson
D-C. (Divisions).

各区主管将采取一切可能的预防措施以防止发生事故，并充分利用其手下警力。

Plan To Celebrate The Fall Of Singapore

I. Purpose
Mainly the City Government and the Social
Movement Direction Committee will be responsible
for the carrying out of a propaganda campaign
among the Chinese people by holding a People's
Congratulatory Meeting, flag parades, and lecture-
meetings, scattering handbills and running decorated
tramcars etc.

II. Events
1) People's Congratulatory Meeting
a.- Time: From 2 p.m. on the day of the entry
into Singapore.
b.- Place: Shanghai Race Course.
c.- Number of attendants: From 150,000 to 200,000
persons.

2) Civil parade
a.- Time: After the People's Congratulatory Meeting.
b.- Route: From Shanghai Race Course via Bubbling
Well Road, Nanking Road, the Bund, Rue
du Consulate, Montigny Road, the Great
World, Edward Avenue VII and Mohawk Road
to Shanghai Race Course.
(The parade will disperse at the Race Course)

3) Letting off of fireworks
a.- Time: At 6 p.m.
b.- Place: In the Shanghai Race Course.

4) Hoisting of national flags
All Chinese governmental offices, shops and
residences will hoist national flags.

5) Floating of 10 balloons
Place: The Bund, Shanghai Race Course, the City Cham-
ber of Commerce, Bubbling Well Road, Shanghai

庆祝新加坡陷落计划

一、目的
主要由市政府和社会运动指导委员会负责，通过举行民众庆贺大会、旗帜游行、讲座会议、散发传单以及运行装饰电车等方式，在中国民众中开展宣传运动。

二、活动
1) 民众庆贺大会
a.- 时间：进入新加坡之日下午2时起。
b.- 地点：上海跑马厅。
c.- 参加人数：15万至20万人。

2) 民间游行
a.- 时间：民众庆贺大会之后。
b.- 路线：从上海跑马厅出发，经静安寺路、南京路、外滩、领事馆路、孟斗班路、大世界、爱多亚七世路（Edward Avenue VII）和莫霍克路，返回上海跑马厅。
（游行队伍在跑马厅解散）

3) 燃放烟花
a.- 时间：下午6时。
b.- 地点：上海跑马厅内。

4) 悬挂国旗
所有中国政府机关、商店和住宅均须悬挂国旗。

5) 放飞10只气球
地点：外滩、上海跑马厅、上海市总商会、静安寺路、上海

page_data.en:
-2-
Station, Pootung, Nantao, Hongkew, French Park
and Siccawei.
6) Erection of congratulatory arches
Place: Shanghai Race Course, the Great World, the
corner of Nanking Road and Chekiang Road.
7) Running of decorated tramcars (5 tramcars each affixed
with 1 trailer)
a.- Place: The International Settlement, the French
Concession and Hongkew.
Note: If the fall of Singapore occurs in the morning,
these tramcars will be run on the following
day; if it occurs in the afternoon, the tram-
cars will be run on the day after next.
b.- Number of day: for 2 days.
c.- Expenses: promoters of this event will defray the
expenses.
8) Radio broadcasts
Special broadcasts will be made by Chinese to celebrate
the fall of Singapore.
9) Mobile Lecture Delivering Corps on the streets
4 decorated motor-trucks will be provided for this
purpose. Each of these trucks will carry 8 persons
and will start at 10 a.m. to deliver public lectures
and to scatter handbills.
a.- One of the trucks will proceed from the Great World
to Rte. Pere Robert via Nanyang Bridge(南洋桥),
Taiping Bridge(太平桥 ), Rue du Marche and Rue
Lafayette.
b.- Three trucks will respectively take the following
routes in the International Settlement:
First route:- From Yu Ya Ching Road via Peking Road,
North Chekiang Road, North Honan Road
and Honan Road to Foochow Road.
Second route: From Nanking Road to the Bubbling Well
page_data.zh:
-2-
火车站、浦东、南市、虹口、法国公园和徐家汇。
6) 搭建庆贺牌坊
地点：上海跑马厅、大世界、南京路与浙江路交叉口。
7) 运行装饰电车（每辆电车挂1节拖车，共5辆）
a.- 地点：公共租界、法租界和虹口。
注意：如果新加坡陷落发生在上午，这些电车将于次日运行；如果发生在下午，则于后天运行。
b.- 天数：2天。
c.- 费用：本次活动发起人承担费用。
8) 无线电广播
华人将进行特别广播以庆祝新加坡陷落。
9) 街头流动演讲队
为此目的提供4辆装饰卡车。每辆卡车载有8人，将于上午10时出发，进行公开演讲并散发传单。
a.- 其中一辆卡车将从大世界出发，经南洋桥、太平桥、菜市路（Rue du Marche）和霞飞路（Rue Lafayette）前往神父路（Rte. Pere Robert）。
b.- 三辆卡车将分别在公共租界沿以下路线行驶：
第一条路线：从虞洽卿路出发，经北京路、北浙江路、北河南路和河南路至福州路。
第二条路线：从南京路至静安寺

page_data.en:
-3-
Temple via Bubbling Well Road.
Third route: From Avenue Road to the Bubbling Well Temple.
10) Posters
Posters will be affixed on all streets, to tramcars and
ricshaws in the Foreign Settlements and in all amusement
resorts, hotels and restaurants in Pootung, Eastern
Shanghai and Western Shanghai.
11) Cloth-banners inscribed slogans will be hung at the
at the following places:
In the French Concession
Clock Tower(the former site of the French Municipal
Council's building on Rte. du Consulat), Rue Hue,
the Great World, Nanyang Bridge, Taiping Bridge, the cor-
ner of Avenue Joffre and Avenue Dubail, the corner of
Avenue Foch and (Edward Avenue) VII and the corner of
Avenue Foch and Rue de Soeurs.
In the International Settlement
The Bowling Club(抛球场) at the corner of Nanking
Road and Honan Road, the New World, Zi Zung Jao(Yu Ya
Ching Road), Lau Si Jao(Chekiang Road Bridge), the
corner of Peking and Honan Roads, the Hardoon Garden,
Wang Ka Soo(the corner of Carter and Bubbling Well Roads),
Tung Sin Jao(south end of Chekiang Road), the corner of
Foochow and Fukien Roads, Carter Road, Chengtu Road,
Sinza Road, the corner of Yu Ya Ching and Foochow Roads.
Tzuh Sun Leu(日昇楼) at the corner of Nanking and
Chekiang Roads and the Bubbling Well Temple.
Eastern Shanghai
Garden Bridge, Chapoo Road Bridge, Szechuen Road Bridge,
Yu Ya Ching Road Bridge(新垃圾桥), Wayside Inn
(the corner of Woosung and Range Roads), Waipang
Bridge, Hongkew Market(三角场), North Szechuen Road
and Range Road.
Western Shanghai
The corner of Jessfield and Bubbling Well Road, Jess-
page_data.zh:
-3-
经静安寺路前往静安寺。
第三条路线：从爱文义路至静安寺。
10) 海报
海报将张贴于公共租界的所有街道、电车及黄包车上，以及浦东、沪东和沪西的所有娱乐场所、旅馆和餐馆。
11) 书写标语的布旗将悬挂于以下地点：
法租界
钟楼（原领事馆路法国公董局大楼旧址）、霞飞路、大世界、南洋桥、太平桥、霞飞路与杜美路转角、福煦路与（爱德华路）七号路转角，以及福煦路与修女院路转角。
公共租界
南京路与河南路转角的抛球场、新世界、浙江路（虞洽卿路）的老闸桥、浙江路桥、北京路与河南路转角、哈同花园、王家沙（卡德路与静安寺路转角）、浙江路南端的天后宫桥、福州路与福建路转角、卡德路、成都路、新闸路、虞洽卿路与福州路转角。
南京路与浙江路转角的日昇楼以及静安寺。
沪东
外白渡桥、乍浦路桥、四川路桥、虞洽卿路桥（新垃圾桥）、吴淞路与雷恩路转角的路边旅店、外虹桥、三角场、四川北路与雷恩路。
沪西
极司菲尔路与静安寺路转角、极司

page_data.en:

field Park, Vai Wang Doo(梵王渡), Ng Koh Zang
(五角場), the corner of Great Western and Bubbling
Well Roads, Robison Road, the corner of Edinburgh
and Great Western Roads, the corner of Edinburgh and
Yu Yuen Roads, Edinburgh Road near the the Western
Shanghai Office.
Chapei
Paosan Road, the Shanghai Station, Stone Bridge,
and Wutseng Road Bridge(烏麗路橋).
Nan tao
Siccawei, Zar Jao(斜橋), Nanyang Jao(南陽橋),
Old West Gate(老西門), Rue Hue, Old North Gate
(老北門), Small East Gate(小東門), Fang Pang
Road(方浜路) and Wang Ka Doo(黃家渡).
Pootung
Tung Chong Road(東昌路), Tang Jao(塘橋), Jee

Kau Miao(高廟).

菲尔公园、梵王渡、五角場、大西路与静安寺路转角、罗别根路、爱丁堡路与大西路转角、爱丁堡路与愚园路转角、爱丁堡路靠近沪西办事处地段。
闸北
宝山路、上海火车站、石桥头、以及乌丽路桥。
南市
徐家汇、斜桥、南阳桥、老西门、霞飞路、老北门、小东门、方浜路和黄家渡。
浦东
东昌路、塘桥、其昌栈、南码头和高庙。

DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
FEB. 18 1942
(DIVISIONS)
DATES FOR THE CELEBRATION OF THE FALL OF SINGAPORE

February 18 (1st Day)

1) Affixing slogans.
2) Scattering of handbills (Employees of the Post Office will be utilized).
3) Raising of national flags.
4) Cloth banners will be hung across various streets.
5) Mayor Chen Kung Po will broadcast over the Greater Shanghai Broadcasting Station.
6) Decorated tramcars will be run on February 18 and 19.
7) Erecting of arches.
8) Letting off fireworks at the Race Course between 7 p.m. and 8 p.m.
9) A grand meeting of representatives of various bodies will be held at 2 p.m. in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. About 5,000 persons will attend the meeting.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 19 FEB 1942）
February 19 (2nd Day): Street Propaganda Day

From 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. four street mobile lecture vehicles will be sent to distribute handbills and to deliver lectures in the two Foreign Settlements. One vehicle will operate in the International Settlement and the remaining three in the French Concession. The route to be taken will be the same as mentioned according to paragraph 9 in the previous report forwarded on February 10.

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI 22 FEB 1942）
page_data.zh:

副总监
1942年2月18日
（各部门）
庆祝新加坡沦陷的活动日期

2月18日（第一天）

1) 张贴标语。
2) 散发传单（将利用邮局员工）。
3) 悬挂国旗。
4) 在各条街道悬挂布旗。
5) 陈公博市长将通过大上海广播电台发表广播讲话。
6) 装饰过的电车将于2月18日和19日运行。
7) 搭建牌楼。
8) 晚上7点至8点在跑马厅燃放烟花。
9) 下午2点将在上海总商会举行各界代表盛大集会。约5,000人将出席该会议。

（印：上海公共租界警务处总监办公室 1942年2月19日）
2月19日（第二天）：街头宣传日

上午10点至下午5点，四辆街头流动宣讲车将被派往两个外国租界分发传单并进行演讲。一辆车在公共租界活动，其余三辆在法租界活动。行驶路线将与2月10日提交的上一份报告第9段中所述相同。

（印：上海警务处总监办公室 1942年2月22日）

page_data.en:
2 ) 50 street lecture corps consisting of 5 persons
each will set out for various streets and public
places to give lectures at 1 p.m. 30 of the
corps will set out in the International Settlement,
15 in the French Concession and 5 in Nantao. Each
of these corps will stop at one point for about
10 minutes.
3) From 7.30 p.m. to 8 p.m., a film of the Great East
Asia War will be screened at the Race Course. In
case of inclement weather, it will be shown in the
building of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
Necessary police protection is desired.
4) A movement to secure signatures will be started on
the same day. Signatures will be given voluntarily.
During the movement of the past two weeks, signatures
of some 1,200,000 persons will be secured.
5) Mr. Chow Fu Hai or Mr. Ting Muh Tsung will broadcast
over the Greater Shanghai Broadcasting Station
between 9 p.m. and 9.30 p.m.
6) There will be a procession of decorated tramcars.

February 20 (3rd Day): Sino-Japanese Lien Hwen Day

1) At noon, a Sino-Japanese Lien Hwen Meeting will be
held on the 14th floor of the Park Hotel, at which
well-known persons and representatives of public
bodies will attend to entertain officers of various
organs of the friendly nation.
2) Various organizations and well-known persons will
jointly send a telegram of respect to President
Wang Ching Wei and a telegram of congratulation
page_data.zh:
2) 由5人组成的50个街头宣讲队将于下午1点出发，前往各街道和公共场所进行演讲。其中30个队在公共租界出发，15个在法租界，5个在南市。每个宣讲队将在一个地点停留约10分钟。
3) 晚上7:30至8点，将在跑马厅放映大东亚战争电影。如遇恶劣天气，改在上海总商会大楼内放映。需要必要的警力保护。
4) 当天将启动签名运动。签名基于自愿原则。在过去两周的运动中，已征集到约1,200,000人的签名。
5) 周佛海先生或丁默邨先生将于晚上9点至9:30通过大上海广播电台发表广播讲话。
6) 将有装饰过的电车游行。

2月20日（第三天）：中日联欢日

1) 中午，将在国际饭店14楼举行中日联欢会，知名人士和各团体代表将出席，招待友邦各机关官员。
2) 各组织和知名人士将联合向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向日本首相、陆军省、海军省、日本派遣军总部和日本大使馆发送贺电

page_data.en:
to the Japanese Prime Minister, the Ministry of Army,
the Ministry of Navy, the Japanese Expeditionary
Forces Headquarters and the Japanese Embassy.
3) A Government official or a well-known person of the
community will be invited to speak over the Greater
Shanghai Broadcasting Station between 9 p.m. and
9.30 p.m.
4) Well-known persons will write articles to be
published in the special supplements and will also
send a joint circular telegram to Chungking.

February 21 (4th Day)

1) A People's Congratulatory Meeting will be held at
the Shanghai Race Course at 2 p.m. About 150,000
persons will attend the meeting. ~~The meeting will~~
~~come to a close at 3 p.m.~~
2) At about 3.30 p.m. after the People's Congratulatory
Meeting, a Civil Parade will proceed along the route
previously fixed. Ten Batches, each comprising 1,000
persons, will participate in the Parade. After the
first batch leaves the Race Course, the remaining
batches will follow one after another at an interval
of 5 minutes. When proceeding along the streets,
persons in the batches will scatter handbills containing
slogans.
140,000 out of the 150,000 persons attending the People's
Congratulatory Meeting will disperse after the last
batch has left the Race Course.
Lieut.-General Sawada and some 30 other officers will
inspect the parade from the 14th floor of the Park H□
The Parade will end at 6 or 7 p.m.
page_data.zh:
3) 将邀请政府官员或社区知名人士于晚上9点至9:30通过大上海广播电台发表讲话。
4) 知名人士将撰写文章刊登在特刊上，并还将向重庆发送联合通电信。

2月21日（第四天）

1) 下午2点将在上海跑马厅举行民众庆祝大会。约150,000人将出席大会。~~会议将于~~ ~~下午3点结束。~~
2) 下午约3:30，民众庆祝大会结束后，市民游行队伍将沿此前确定的路线行进。十个批次参加游行，每批1,000人。第一批离开跑马厅后，其余批次将每隔5分钟依次跟随。在街道行进时，各批次人员将散发包含标语的传单。
参加民众庆祝大会的150,000人中，有140,000人将在最后一批离开跑马厅后解散。
泽田中将和其他约30名军官将从国际饭店14楼检阅游行队伍。
游行将于下午6点或7点结束。

page_data.en:
February 22 (5th Day): Propaganda Day By Agriculturists
1) Meeting of agriculturists will be held in Pootung at
10 a.m.
2) The seven districts of Shanghai will each simultaneously
hold a mass meeting.
3) The meeting of representatives of agriculturists will
select representatives to offer congratulations to the
superior officers of the friendly nation.
4) The mass meeting of each district will select represen-
tatives to offer congratulations to the superior
officers of the friendly nation.
5) Agricultural organizations and public bodies of each
district will each send a telegram of respect to
President Wang Ching-wei and offer congratulations to
the friendly nation.
6) Village lecturing corps will be formed to undertake
propaganda in villages at 2 p.m.

February 23 (6th Day): Propaganda Day Of Labour Circle
1) Meeting of representatives of workers will be held at
the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce at 10 a.m.
2) Meeting will select representatives to tender
congratulations to the superior officers of the friendly
nation.
3) Each of the workers' bodies will send a telegram of
respect to President Wang Ching-wei and will also pay
respects to the competent organs of the friendly nation.
4) At 6 p.m. moving pictures of the Great East Asia War
will be shown for the benefit of workers. It will be
held at the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce.
page_data.zh:
2月22日（第五天）：农民宣传日
1) 上午10点在浦东举行农民大会。
2) 上海七个区将同时举行群众大会。
3) 农民代表会议将选出代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
4) 各区的群众大会将选出代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
5) 各区的农业组织和公共团体将分别向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向友邦表示祝贺。
6) 下午2点将组建乡村宣讲队，在村庄开展宣传工作。

2月23日（第六天）：劳工界宣传日
1) 上午10点在上海总商会举行工人代表会议。
2) 会议将选出代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
3) 各工人群体将向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向友邦主管机关致敬。
4) 下午6点将为工人放映大东亚战争电影。地点在上海总商会。

page_data.en:
7th Day : Commercial Circles' Propaganda Day

1) Meeting of representatives of commercial circles to
be held at 10 a.m. in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
2) Representatives to be elected at the meeting to offer
congratulations to officials of the friendly nation.
3) All commercial public bodies should send a telegram
of respect and congratulations to President Wang Ching Wei
and to friendly organizations.
4) Labourers' and Merchants' Lien Hwen Association will
give a dinner party to officials of the Nanking
Government and the friendly nation at 5 p.m. in the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce.

8th Day : Students' Propaganda Day

1) At 10 a.m. a meeting of students' representatives
will be held in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
2) At the meeting, representatives will be elected to
pay respects to officials of the friendly nation.
3) All youths' and students' public bodies will send
telegrams of respect and congratulations to President
Wang Ching Wei and to the organizations of the
friendly nation.
4) Between 2 and 6 p.m. football and basketball matches
will be played at the Canidrome. 20,000 people are
expected to attend. The proceeds from the admission
tickets will be used to relieve refugees in the South
Sea Islands.

9th Day : Religious Circles' Propaganda Day

1) A meeting of representatives of religious circles
will be held at 10 a.m. in the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce.
page_data.zh:
第七天：商界宣传日

1) 上午10点在上海总商会举行商界代表会议。
2) 会议将选举代表，向友邦官员致贺。
3) 所有商业公共团体应向汪精卫主席发送致敬和祝贺电，并向友好组织致意。
4) 劳工商联会将于下午5点在上海总商会设宴招待南京政府和友邦官员。

第八天：学生宣传日

1) 上午10点在上海总商会举行学生代表会议。
2) 会议上将选举代表，向友邦官员致敬。
3) 所有青年和学生公共团体将向汪精卫主席发送致敬和祝贺电，并向友邦组织致意。
4) 下午2点至6点将在逸园举行足球和篮球比赛。预计有20,000人出席。门票收入将用于救济南洋群岛的难民。

第九天：宗教界宣传日

1) 上午10点在上海总商会举行宗教界代表会议。

page_data.en:
2) At the meeting, representatives will be elected to pay
respects to officials of the friendly nation.
3) All educational bodies will send a telegram of
respect and congratulations to President Wang Ching Wei
and to organizations of the friendly nation.
4) Notables of educational circles will be invited to
speak over the Greater Shanghai Radio Station.

10th Day : Cultural Circles' Propaganda Day
1) A meeting of representatives of newspapers, news
agencies and cultural bodies will be held at 10 a.m.
in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
2) At the meeting, representatives will be elected to
offer congratulations to the officials of the friendly
nation.
3) All cultural bodies, newspapers and news agencies will
send a telegram of respect to President Wang Ching Wei
and to organizations of the friendly nation.
4) At 2 p.m. a tea party to discuss the emancipation of
the South Sea Islands will be held in the Hotel Pacific.

11th Day : Women's Propaganda Day
1) At 10 a.m. a meeting of women representatives will be
held at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
2) At the meeting representatives will be elected to
offer congratulations to officials of the friendly
nation.
3) All women bodies will send a telegram of respect and
congratulations to President Wang Ching Wei and to
organizations of the friendly nation.
4) Between 9 and 9.30 p.m. songs will be broadcasted
through the Greater Shanghai Radio Station.
page_data.zh:
2) 会议上将选举代表，向友邦官员致敬。
3) 所有教育团体将向汪精卫主席发送致敬和祝贺电，并向友邦组织致意。
4) 将邀请教育界名人通过大上海广播电台发表讲话。

第十天：文化界宣传日
1) 上午10点在上海总商会举行报纸、通讯社和文化团体代表会议。
2) 会议上将选举代表，向友邦官员致贺。
3) 所有文化团体、报纸和通讯社将向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向友邦组织致意。
4) 下午2点将在太平洋饭店举行茶话会，讨论南洋群岛的解放问题。

第十一天：妇女宣传日
1) 上午10点在上海总商会举行妇女代表会议。
2) 会议上将选举代表，向友邦官员致贺。
3) 所有妇女团体将向汪精卫主席发送致敬和祝贺电，并向友邦组织致意。
4) 晚上9点至9:30将通过大上海广播电台播放歌曲。

page_data.en:
12th Day: Citizens' Propagating Day
1) Meeting of representatives of citizens to be held
at the Chinese Chamber of Commerce at 10 a.m.
2) Meeting to detail representatives to offer
congratulations to high officials of the friendly
nation.
3) Various Citizens' Federations to dispatch telegrams
of respect to President Wang Ching Wei and telegrams
of congratulations to organizations of the friendly
nation.
4) To promote a movement for citizens to make
contributions for the comfort of the officers and
men at the front engaged in the war for the
emancipation of Great Asia.
page_data.zh:
第十二天：市民宣传日
1) 上午10点在上海总商会举行市民代表会议。
2) 会议将指派代表，向友邦高级官员致贺。
3) 各市民联合会将向汪精卫主席发送致敬电，并向友邦组织发送贺电。
4) 推动市民捐款运动，以慰劳从事大亚洲解放战争的前线官兵。

page_data.en:
13th Day : Propagating Days of the Special Bodies

1) At 10 a.m. representatives of various countrymen's
associations and special bodies will hold a meeting.
2) The meeting will appoint delegates to tender con-
gratulations to officers of the friendly army.
3) Various special bodies will send a telegram of respect
to President Wang Ching-wei and telegrams of con-
gratulation to organs of the friendly nation.
4) From 2 p.m. to stage boxing at the Chamber of
Commerce.
5) Meeting of Asiatic People will be held on the 13th
floor, Park Hotel.

14th Days Auction (To be also held on the 15th
and 16th days)

Auction of paintings, calligraphy and photographs.
The Ministry of Information of the Friendly Nation
will be requested to supply war pictures, and Chinese
and Japanese artists to supply their work. Funds
collected from the auction will be used for the
relief of refugees in the South Sea Islands.

15th Days Entertainments (To be held in The
Sun Company)

1) Half admission charge to the Great World Amusement
Resort and Tien Yuen Lou.
2) Programmes for the emancipation of the South Pacific
will be given in the Carlton Theatre by solo performer.
3) Well known Shanghai dramatist will present a program
in Tien Chuen Theatre.
4) Peking drama will be presented at Wang King Theatre.
5) Modern plays will be presented in Dah Wu Dai Theatre.
6) Eastern Asia program will be given by story tellers.
page_data.zh:
第十三日：各特别团体宣传日

1) 上午十时，各同乡会及特别团体代表将举行会议。
2) 会议将指派代表向友军军官致贺。
3) 各特别团体将向汪精卫主席发送致敬电报，并向友邦机关发送祝贺电报。
4) 下午二时起，在商会进行舞台拳击表演。
5) 亚洲人会议将在国际饭店十三楼举行。

第十四日：拍卖（亦将于第十五日及第十六日举行）

书画及照片拍卖。
请友邦情报部提供战争图片，并请中日艺术家提供作品。拍卖所得款项将用于救济南洋群岛难民。

第十五日：娱乐活动（在大新公司举行）

1) 大世界游乐场及天韵楼门票半价。
2) 卡尔登戏院将由独唱演员演出“大太平洋解放”节目。
3) 上海著名戏剧家将在天蟾舞台演出节目。
4) 王京大戏院将上演京剧。
5) 大舞台将上演话剧。
6) 说书人将表演“东亚”节目。

page_data.en:
Appendix

1) Sin Wan Pao and Shun Pao will be distributed in the
interior.
2) Special editions of Bing Pao and Central China Daily
News will be distributed in the interior.
3) A special publication will be issued at the end of two
weeks.
4) Telegrams of congratulation will be dispatched to the
following persons:
1. President Wang Ching-wei.
2. Premier Tojo.
3. War Minister Tojo
4. Message of congratulation to the Japanese Navy Depart-
ment. (Title: Admiral Shimada)
(2. 3. and 4. will immediately be sent to Tokyo).
5. Message of congratulation to the Headquarters of
the Japanese Expeditionary Force in China (Title:
Commander Hata).
6. Message of congratulation of the Japanese Embassy.
(Title: Ambassador Shigemitsu).
(5 and 6 will immediately be sent to Nanking).
7. Representatives will be detailed to various organs
of our friendly nation such as the garrison force,
the gendarmerie, the special service office, the
consulate etc. to tender congratulations.
page_data.zh:
附录

1) 《新闻报》及《申报》将在内地分发。
2) 《晶报》及《华中日报》特刊将在内地分发。
3) 两周后将发行特刊。
4) 祝贺电报将发往以下人士：
1. 汪精卫主席。
2. 东条英机首相。
3. 东条英机陆军大臣
4. 致日本海军省祝贺信。（头衔：岛田繁太郎海军大将）
（第2、3及4项将立即发送至东京）。
5. 致日本中国派遣军总部祝贺信。（头衔：畑俊六司令官）。
6. 致日本大使馆祝贺信。（头衔：重光葵大使）。
（第5及6项将立即发送至南京）。
7. 将派遣代表至友邦各机关，如驻防部队、宪兵队、特务机关、领事馆等，以表祝贺。

A.C. (Special Branch)

With reference to my Memo of February 18, 1942
re "Celebrations of fall of Singapore" the following
additional information is now available regarding the
Civil Parade to be held on the Race Course at 2 p.m.
Monday February 23, instead of February 21 as orggin-
ally scheduled.

The crowd will start to enter at 1 p.m. Entrance
will be by the main gates opposite Myburgh Road only.
Mohawk Road gates will be closed. The procession will
leave by the Lung Fei gate and traverse the route
given in my Memo of February 18, to Mohawk and Race
Course Roads where it will disperse. The estimated
time en route is about 2 hours.

Police will be posted at all intersections en
route and every possible precaution must be taken to
prevent an incident. All avenues of escape must be
blocked.

Police will be posted at intervals round the bam-
boo fence of the Race Course on Race Course Road and
Mohawk Road. One Reserve Unit will take up position
inside the main entrance (near the clock tower) at 1 p.m.
and will remain until the grounds are cleared. One
Reserve Unit will be at the disposal of the D.O. "A" at
Louza Station from 1 p.m. and one Reserve Unit will
stand by at Gordon Road.

D.O. "A" will post all available C.P.C.s and
Chinese detectives inside the grounds. It is imperative
that Chinese detectives carry their Warrant Cards with
them as a means of identification as all persons entering
the grounds will be searched by the sponsors of the
Parade. The following S.M.P. (Specials) will report for
duty at the Station mentioned at 1 p.m. on the day of
the Parade.

Central Station 11th Division 20 men
Louza " 14th " 20 "
Chengtu Road " 12th " 8 "
" " 15th " 20 "
Sinza " 10th " 20 "
" " 13th " 10 "

Three platoons of the Chinese company S.V.C., com-
prising approximately 100 men, will stand by at the Drill
Hall and if their services are required may be had
through S.V.C. Headquarters. In the event of their
services being required, transportation will be provided
by the S.V.C.

参照我于1942年2月18日关于“新加坡陷落庆祝活动”的备忘录，现就原定于2月21日、现改期至2月23日星期一下午二时在跑马厅举行的民间游行，提供以下补充信息。

人群将于下午一时开始入场。入口仅限迈尔西爱路对面的正门。莫霍克路大门将关闭。游行队伍将从龙飞门离开，并按照我2月18日备忘录中给出的路线行进，至莫霍克路及跑马厅路后解散。预计途中耗时约两小时。

警方将部署在沿途所有交叉路口，必须采取一切可能的预防措施以防止发生事故。所有逃生通道必须被封锁。

警方将间隔部署在跑马厅路及莫霍克路跑马厅竹篱笆周围。一支后备队将于下午一时在正门内（钟楼附近）就位，并停留至场地清空。一支后备队自下午一时起供“A”区主管警官在老闸捕房调遣，另一支后备队在戈登路待命。

“A”区主管警官将在场地内部署所有可用的中国巡捕及华人侦探。华人侦探务必携带委任证作为身份证明，因为所有进入场地的人员都将受到游行主办方的搜查。下列工部局警务处（特别巡捕）人员将于游行当日中午十二点前在指定捕房报到执勤。

"Celebrations of Fall of Singapore", a Civil parade which will
be attended by approximately 50,000 people will be held in the
Race Course at 2 p.m. on February 21st. After the parade
10,000 of the participants will leave the Race Course in batches
of 1,000 each at 5 minutes interval, and proceed via Bubbling
Well Road, Nanking Road, The Bund, Avenue Edward VII, Rue du
Consulat, Rue de Montigny, Avenue Edward VII, to Mohawk Road,
where it will disperse. Divisional Officers will instruct the
Officers in charge to take all possible precautions along the
line of route. Every Available policeman will be on duty, and
at intersections onlookers should be kept back to a distance of
100 yards from the line of procession.

The celebrations in connection with the fall of Singapore
will extend over a period of 15 days, starting from February 18,
1942. A comprehensive list of these celebrations will be issued
later. Pending the issue of this list the following is a pro-
gramme to be observed on the second day of the celebrations,
February 19, 1942.

Speeches will be delivered at various points in the
Settlement, chiefly South of the Creek, from 3 motor cars
and leaflets will be distributed.

30 parties, each consisting of 5 men, will deliver
speeches at various points in the Settlement.

Cinematograph exhibitions of war pictures will be
held on the Race Course from 7 to 8 p.m. If the weather
is wet the display will take place in the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce.

Books will be placed at different points in the Settle-
ment in which members of the Chinese population will be
invited to record their adherence to The Social Movement in
celebrations of the fall of Singapore.

Decorated street cars operating on the streets on
February 18 will continue to operate throughout the day of
February 19.

Divisional Officers will adopt every possible precaution to
prevent an incident and will use their men to the fullest
advantage.

战争题材的电影放映将于晚上7时至8时在跑马厅举行。如果天气下雨，放映将在上海总商会进行。

书籍将放置在租界内的不同地点，邀请中国居民在其中记录他们对“社会运动”的拥护，以庆祝新加坡陷落。

2月18日在街道上运营的装饰电车将继续在2月19日全天运营。

各区警官将采取一切可能的预防措施以防止发生事故，并将充分利用其手下警力。

Parade held in connection with the fall of Singapore.

Sir,
It is estimated that 300,000 persons representing some 48 labour unions took part in the parade held on Feb. 23 to celebrate the fall of Singapore.
The procession entered Central District at 3p.m. and proceeded down Nanking Road and The Bund to Avenue Edward VII, turning off into the French Concession at the intersection of Avenue Edward VII and Route de la Porte du Nord.
Barricades were erected at all important road intersections and extra police were posted along the entire route.
The district was opened to pedestrian and vehicular traffic at 4.30p.m. at which time the last detachment of the procession entered the French Concession.
Naval and military patrols were also posted at all strategic points.
No untoward incident occurred.

S. 1, Special Branch. $/dt/dn. File No.................... Date....February 21, 1942..

SUBJECT: Celebration of the fall of Singapore.

In celebration of the fall of Singapore,
the Shanghai Special Municipal Government on
February 19th, despatched four Post Office motor-
trucks, licence Nos. 15973, 16938, 16500, and
16359 to tour various streets in the Settlement.
The vehicles were covered with posters bearing
pro-Japanese cartoons and slogans. Between 12.30 p.m.
and 1.15 p.m. the vehicles were observed parked
in the vicinity of the New World Amusement Resort,
corner of Bubbling Well and Yu Ya Ching Roads.

Whilst parked in the above locality, a large
quantity of coloured leaflets of a pro-Japanese
nature was distributed. No lectures, however,
were observed to have been given from the trucks.

A list in tabular form of the handbills
which came into the possession of the Police on
the occasion, giving a brief summary of the
contents of the literature is attached hereto
together with specimens of the handbills.

With reference to my Memo of February 18, 1942
re "Celebrations of fall of Singapore" the following
additional information is now available regarding the
Civil Parade to be held on the Race Course at 2 p.m.
Monday February 23, instead of February 21 as origin-
ally scheduled.

The crowd will start to enter at 1 p.m. Entrance
will be by the main gates opposite Ayburgh Road only.
Mohawk Road gates will be closed. The procession will
leave by the Lung Fei gate and traverse the route
given in my Memo of February 18, to Mohawk and Race
Course Roads where it will disperse. The estimated
time en route is about 2 hours.

Police will be posted at all intersections en
route and every possible precaution must be taken to
prevent an incident. All avenues of escape must be
blocked.

Police will be posted at intervals round the bam-
boo fence of the Race Course on Race Course Road and
Mohawk Road. One Reserve Unit will take up position
inside the main entrance (near the clock tower) at 1 p.m.
and will remain until the grounds are cleared. One
Reserve Unit will be at the disposal of the D.C. "A" at
Louza Station from 1 p.m. and one Reserve Unit will
stand by at Gordon Road.

D.C. "A" will post all available C.P.C.s and
Chinese detectives inside the grounds. It is imperative
that Chinese detectives carry their Warrant Cards with
them as a means of identification as all persons entering
the grounds will be searched by the sponsors of the
Parade. The following S.M.P. (Specials) will report for
duty at the Station mentioned at 1 p.m. on the day of
the Parade.

by the S.V.C.

人群将于下午1时开始入场。仅通过对面为艾伯格路（Ayburgh Road）的正门进入。莫霍克路（Mohawk Road）的大门将关闭。游行队伍将从龙飞门（Lung Fei gate）离开，并按照我2月18日备忘录中给出的路线行进，至莫霍克路和跑马厅路，并在那里解散。预计途中耗时约2小时。

警察将部署在沿途所有交叉路口，必须采取一切可能的预防措施以防止发生事故。所有逃生通道必须被封锁。

警察将间隔部署在跑马厅路和莫霍克路跑马厅竹篱笆周围。一个后备分队将于下午1时在正门内（靠近钟楼）就位，并停留至场地清空。一个后备分队将于下午1时起在老闸捕房听候“A”区副巡官调遣，另一个后备分队将在戈登路待命。

“A”区副巡官将部署所有可用的中国警员（C.P.C.s）和华人侦探进入场地内。华人侦探必须随身携带委任证作为身份证明，因为所有进入场地的人员都将受到游行主办方的搜查。下列上海公共租界工部局警务处（特别警察）将于游行当日中午1时在提到的捕房报到执勤。

Celebration of Fall of Singapore - in Footung

At 2 p.m. on February 20, 1942, in celebration
of the fall of Singapore, the Footung Southern District
Administrative Office, Tung Chong Road, Footung, held a
general meeting of Footung residents in the front compound
of the above premises. Some 1,000 persons who attended
were chiefs of all villages, representatives of various
labour unions, schools and other public bodies, policemen,
etc. Tsui Nyoh Tsung (朱玉珍), Officer-in-Charge of
District
the Footung Southern Administrative Office, presided over
the meeting and delivered the following speech:-

"For a great number of years the peoples of the
Great Orient have been exploited and oppressed by
the British and Americans. Now the enemies have
been defeated by our friendly troops. Their most
important base in the Far East, Singapore, has
also been occupied by the Japanese army. It is,
therefore, believed that the peoples of the Orient
will soon be emancipated."

Mr. Yamamoto, Commander of the Japanese
Gendarmerie Detachment at Tung Chong Road, Footung, Chang
Ching Pao (張慶宝), representative of the commercial
circles in Footung, and Mr. Shimizu, a Japanese subject,
also made speeches. The contents of their speeches were
of a similar nature, explaining the importance of the
occupation of Singapore by Japanese troops. The meeting
terminated at 3.30 p.m. amidst the loud shouting of slogans.

After the meeting, under the auspices of the
Administrative Office, those attending formed a procession.
The procession proceeded along Tung Chong Road, via Zau
Road
Daung (善堂路), China Chou Road (警局路) and New
Street and returned to the Administrative Office Compound,
where they dispersed.

（左侧手写批注：D.e. b. SB" / 23. 2. 42. / Sffuss. / P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)）

庆祝新加坡陷落 - 在浦东

1942年2月20日下午2时，为庆祝新加坡陷落，浦东南区公署在浦东同昌路上述处所的前院举行了浦东居民大会。约1000人出席，包括各村村长、各工会、学校及其他公共团体的代表、警察等。浦东南区公署主管朱玉珍（Tsui Nyoh Tsung）主持会议并发表如下演讲：

“多年来，大东方各国人民一直受到英美人的剥削和压迫。现在敌人已被我军击败。他们在远东最重要的基地新加坡也被日军占领。因此，相信东方各国人民很快就会获得解放。”

驻浦东同昌路的日本宪兵队指挥官山本先生（Mr. Yamamoto）、浦东商界代表张庆宝（Chang Ching Pao）以及日本籍人士清水先生（Mr. Shimizu）也发表了讲话。他们的讲话内容性质相似，阐述了日军占领新加坡的重要性。会议在下午3时30分高呼口号声中结束。

会后，在公署的主持下，与会者组成了游行队伍。游行队伍沿同昌路行进，途经善堂路（Zau Road Daung）、警局路（China Chou Road）和新街，最后返回公署大院解散。

（左侧手写批注：D.e. b. SB" / 42年2月23日. / Sffuss. / P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)）

SUBJECT: Pro-Nanking organizations celebrated the Fall of Hongkong

Local pro-Nanking organizations celebrated the fall of Hongkong by holding the following functions on December 29, 1941 :-

Meeting on the Race Course

At 1.50 p.m., December 29, about 20,000 men of the working class as well as a number of primary school students attended a meeting entitled "General Meeting of Shanghai Representatives of the Great Orient Emancipation Movement" (大東亞解放運動上海特別市代表大會) held on the Race Course, Bubbling Well Road. The function commenced with the delivery of a speech by Ling Hsien Wen (林憲文), Commissioner of the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Shanghai Special Municipal Government. He told the audience that Britain and America have oppressed the Oriental Race for the past hundred years and the people in Shanghai and Hongkong have now been emancipated by the occupation of these two places by Japanese forces. He finally expressed the hope that the people of the South Sea Islands would soon be delivered from their sufferings. Speeches of a similar nature were then made by Chen Kung Poh, Mayor of the Shanghai Special Municipal Government, and one Zung Tsoong Yao (鄭宗耀), who claimed to be a representative of Overseas Chinese.

Large quantities of handbills and posters of a pro-Japanese and anti-British and Anti-American nature were distributed throughout Shanghai. Some of these events are mentioned hereunder:-

Plan To Celebrate The Fall of Singapore

I. Purpose
Mainly the City Government and the Social
Movement Direction Committee will be responsible
for the carrying out of a propaganda campaign
among the Chinese people by holding a People's
Congratulatory Meeting, flag parades, and lecture-
meetings, scattering handbills and running decorated
tramcars etc.

II. Events
1) People's Congratulatory Meeting
a. - Time : From 2 p.m. on the day of the entry
into Singapore.
b. - Place: Shanghai Race Course.
c. Number of attendants: From 150,00 to 200,000
persons.

2) Civic parade
a. - Time: After the People's Congratulatory Meeting.
b. - Route: From Shanghai Race Course via Bubbling
Well Road, Nanking Road, the Bund, Rue
du Consulate, Montigny Road, the Great
World, Avenue Edward VII and Mohawk Road
to Shanghai Race Course.
(The parade will disperse at the Race
Course)

3) Letting off of fireworks
a. - Time: At 6 p.m.
b. - Place: In the Shanghai Race Course.

4) Hoisting of national flags
All Chinese governmental offices, shops and
residences will hoist national flags.

5) Floating of 10 balloons
Place: The Bund, Shanghai Race Course, the City
Chamber of Commerce, Bubbling Well Road, Shanghai

庆祝新加坡陷落计划

一、目的
主要由市政府和社会运动指导委员会负责，通过举行民众庆祝大会、旗帜游行、演讲会、散发传单以及运行装饰电车等方式，在中国民众中开展宣传活动。

二、活动
1) 民众庆祝大会
a. - 时间：进入新加坡之日下午2时起。
b. - 地点：上海跑马场。
c. 参加人数：15万至20万人。

2) 市民游行
a. - 时间：民众庆祝大会之后。
b. - 路线：从上海跑马场出发，经静安寺路、南京路、外滩、领事馆路、孟斗班路、大世界、爱多亚路及慕尔鸣路返回上海跑马场。
（游行队伍在跑马场解散）

a. - 时间：下午6时。
b. - 地点：上海跑马场内。

所有中国政府机关、商店和住宅均悬挂国旗。

地点：外滩、上海跑马场、市商会、静安寺路、上海

JAP

PROCLAMATION

WHEREAS, being compelled by the state of war which has arisen between
Japan on one hand and the United States of America and the British Empire on
the other, detachments of the Japanese Army and Navy shall be as from to-day
dispatched in the International Settlement for the suppression of hostile activities
and for the maintenance of peace and order in the area, and

WHEREAS, however, the Japanese Military Authorities, whose first concern
in taking this measure is the maintenance of peace and order and preservation of
the prosperity of the Settlement, are ready to respect the life and property of the
general public, ever in case of nationals of the enemy countries, unless either they
act against the interests of the Japanese forces or their property is liable to hostile
usage.

THE PUBLIC ARE HEREBY URGED that they will rest assured with
the above intention of the Japanese Military Authorities and pursue their daily
work as usual.

IT IS ALSO PROCLAIMED that those who act to the detriment of the
general peace and order or in the enemy's interests, particularly those who act in
contravention of the Japanese Military Regulations, and those who destroy or cause
any damage to the public institutions or the stocks of essential materials shall be
strictly punished in accordance with the Military Regulations.

Commanders-in-Chief of the
Japanese Army and Navy
in the Shanghai Area.

JAP

公告

鉴于日本一方与美利坚合众国及大英帝国另一方之间爆发战争状态，日本陆海军部队自今日起将派遣分队进入公共租界，以镇压敌对活动并维持该地区的和平与秩序，且

鉴于日本军事当局采取此措施的首要关切是维持和平与秩序以及保护租界的繁荣，愿意尊重公众的生命和财产，即使是敌国国民，除非其行为损害日军利益或其财产可能被用于敌对用途。

特此吁请公众放心，相信日本军事当局的上述意图，并照常从事日常工作。

兹又宣告，凡行动损害一般和平与秩序或有利于敌方者，特别是违反日本军规者，以及破坏或致使公共机构或重要物资储备受损者，将依照军规予以严惩。

C.D.S. 230 Chang Yeh attached to this
office was instructed to visit the various bookstores
